name: optical-illusion-grid
title: Optical Illusion Grid
description: Famous Hermann grid optical illusion where phantom dark dots appear at white lane intersections.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Passive Hermann Illusion: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
